Earth is in Solar System, Milky Way, total universe/universe? In Chinese 总星系 often refers to observable universe/all galaxies including Milky Way and extragalactic systems? content:
解析：地球属于太阳系，太阳系属于银河系，银河系属于总星系；而河外星系是指银河系以外的星系，不包括地球。

答案：B
